1.0.1.en:
Availability watchdogs: set the default hours without reporting, wait a few minutes after the app starts, and require a device to stay unavailable for N seconds before it counts. New low battery check with a new Watched device battery is low trigger. Optional Homey timeline entries when a device goes down. Watchdogs of devices that are gone from Homey can be cleaned up in one click. All defaults are in Settings > Availability > Watchdog defaults.
New dashboard widgets: Watchdogs (filter tiles for not reporting, unavailable, low battery and OK, zone names, a Check now button) and Voltage (current reading against your configured band). The Overview widget can now list every monitor, filtered by kind, with a title of your choice. The Sentinel widget header layout is fixed.
Much lower memory use: history moved out of Homey settings into a small local database, the device list is only read when Settings or a Flow card needs it, and the app now answers the memory warnings from Homey. This fixes the out-of-memory crashes seen with long histories.
Activity calibration copes with stray readings and explains why it cannot settle. Daily statistics step one calendar day at a time, so days with a daylight saving change are counted correctly.
You can edit Activity and State monitors after creating them. State groups now fire live match and mismatch triggers.
Settings page restyled with clear tabs and a dark mode.

1.0.7.en:
Activity, State and Voltage monitors can now have their device and name changed from the Edit form, instead of deleting and recreating the monitor (which used to lose its history).
Fill default wording for this type (Group messages) now also covers Italian, Spanish, Swedish, Norwegian and Danish, on top of English, Dutch, German and French.
Number tokens given to Flows are rounded to three decimals, so a total like 3.9199999999999997 kWh now reads 3.92.

1.0.8.en: Voltage messages can use power and energy placeholders and new Voltage monitors start with wording in your Homey language. Cost threshold and phase imbalance fixes, clearer token buttons in Settings, and fixes for deleted or edited monitors and groups.

1.0.9.en: Default message language setting (Portuguese included) for the starting wording of new monitors and groups. Add monitor forms now pick the capability first, then zone and device. Binary Counter removed: Flows using its cards must be edited.

1.0.10.en:
New Activity monitors start their threshold from what Homey Insights already logged, and Rebuild from Insights adds estimated history from before a monitor existed.
Usage pattern: a Pattern view in Settings and a Get usage pattern card show the busiest weekday and hour, how much of the time on falls in the day, and energy and average power by weekday and hour. A new condition tells when a start is at an unusual hour.
New cards: has not been active for N hours, Get standby ranking (who uses the most while idle, also listed in Settings) and Get daily digest (the day in one message).
Availability: a master Availability tracking switch and a Track switch for each device, and the availability triggers now have a message token.
The sentences the app writes itself (availability, calibration, weekly trend, text report, digest) follow the Default message language, so Portuguese works for notifications and speech.
Fixes: the Rebuild route runs in app context and ids from the web can no longer reach Object.prototype. The license is now MIT.
Removed: energy cost (the price setting, the cost tokens, the Cost today exceeds an amount trigger and the Set energy price action). Flows that used them must be edited; the kWh tokens stay.
